# SmartJSONFix

> Free browser-based JSON validator, formatter, and auto-repair tool.

SmartJSONFix validates, formats, beautifies, minifies, and automatically
repairs broken JSON entirely in the browser. No signup, no upload,
no installation. Supports trailing-comma removal, single-quote conversion,
Python-literal conversion, and bracket balancing.

## Core pages
- [Home and Editor](https://smartjsonfix.com/): The main tool interface
- [About](https://smartjsonfix.com/about.html): Features, comparison, FAQ
- [Privacy](https://smartjsonfix.com/privacy.html): Data handling
- [Terms](https://smartjsonfix.com/terms.html): Usage terms

## Key facts
- License: Free, no signup
- Privacy: All processing in-browser, no data uploaded
- Standards: RFC 8259 / ECMA-404
- Auto-repair: trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, Python True/False/None, bracket balancing
